entries.title: Numbers 33:1
segments: ¶These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt in their armies, under the direction of Moses and Aaron.

entries.title: Numbers 33:2
segments: And the stages of their journey on their way out were put down in writing by Moses at the order of the Lord: these are the stages of their journey and the way they went.

entries.title: Numbers 33:3
segments: On the fifteenth day of the first month they went out from Rameses; on the day after the Passover the children of Israel went out by the power of the Lord before the eyes of all the Egyptians,

entries.title: Numbers 33:4
segments: While the Egyptians were placing in the earth the bodies of their sons on whom the Lord had sent destruction: and their gods had been judged by him.

entries.title: Numbers 33:5
segments: So the children of Israel went from Rameses and put up their tents in Succoth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:6
segments: And they went on from Succoth and put up their tents in Etham on the edge of the waste land.

entries.title: Numbers 33:7
segments: And from Etham, turning back to Pi-hahiroth which is before Baal-zephon, they put up their tents before Migdol.

entries.title: Numbers 33:8
segments: And journeying on from before Hahiroth, they went through the sea into the waste land: they went three days' journey through the waste land of Etham and put up their tents in Marah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:9
segments: And from Marah they went on to Elim: and in Elim there were twelve water-springs and seventy palm-trees; and they put up their tents there.

entries.title: Numbers 33:10
segments: And they went on from Elim and put up their tents by the Red Sea.

entries.title: Numbers 33:11
segments: Then from the Red Sea they went on and put up their tents in the waste land of Sin.

entries.title: Numbers 33:12
segments: And they went on from the waste land of Sin, and put up their tents in Dophkah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:13
segments: And they went on from Dophkah, and put up their tents in Alush.

entries.title: Numbers 33:14
segments: And they went on from Alush, and put up their tents in Rephidim, where there was no drinking-water for the people.

entries.title: Numbers 33:15
segments: And they went on from Rephidim, and put up their tents in the waste land of Sinai.

entries.title: Numbers 33:16
segments: And they went on from the waste land of Sinai and put up their tents in Kibroth-hattaavah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:17
segments: And they went on from Kibroth-hattaavah, and put up their tents in Hazeroth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:18
segments: And they went on from Hazeroth, and put up their tents in Rithmah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:19
segments: And they went on from Rithmah, and put up their tents in Rimmon-perez.

entries.title: Numbers 33:20
segments: And they went on from Rimmon-perez, and put up their tents in Libnah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:21
segments: And they went on from Libnah, and put up their tents in Rissah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:22
segments: And they went on from Rissah, and put up their tents in Kehelathah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:23
segments: And they went on from Kehelathah, and put up their tents in Mount Shepher.

entries.title: Numbers 33:24
segments: And they went on from Mount Shepher, and put up their tents in Haradah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:25
segments: And they went on from Haradah, and put up their tents in Makheloth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:26
segments: And they went on from Makheloth, and put up their tents in Tahath.

entries.title: Numbers 33:27
segments: And they went on from Tahath, and put up their tents in Terah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:28
segments: And they went on from Terah, and put up their tents in Mithkah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:29
segments: And they went on from Mithkah, and put up their tents in Hashmonah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:30
segments: And they went on from Hashmonah, and put up their tents in Moseroth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:31
segments: And they went on from Moseroth, and put up their tents in Bene-jaakan.

entries.title: Numbers 33:32
segments: And they went on from Bene-jaakan, and put up their tents in Hor-haggidgad.

entries.title: Numbers 33:33
segments: And they went on from Hor-haggidgad, and put up their tents in Jotbathah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:34
segments: And they went on from Jotbathah, and put up their tents in Abronah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:35
segments: And they went on from Abronah, and put up their tents in Ezion-geber.

entries.title: Numbers 33:36
segments: And they went on from Ezion-geber, and put up their tents in the waste land of Zin (which is Kadesh).

entries.title: Numbers 33:37
segments: And they went on from Kadesh, and put up their tents in Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.

entries.title: Numbers 33:38
segments: And Aaron the priest went up into the mountain at the order of the Lord, and came to his death there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

entries.title: Numbers 33:39
segments: Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old at the time of his death in Mount Hor.

entries.title: Numbers 33:40
segments: And news of the coming of the children of Israel came to the king of Arad, the Canaanite, who was living in the South in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Numbers 33:41
segments: And from Mount Hor they went on, and put up their tents in Zalmonah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:42
segments: And they went on from Zalmonah, and put up their tents in Punon.

entries.title: Numbers 33:43
segments: And they went on from Punon, and put up their tents in Oboth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:44
segments: And they went on from Oboth, and put up their tents in Iye-abarim at the edge of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 33:45
segments: And they went on from Iyim, and put up their tents in Dibon-gad.

entries.title: Numbers 33:46
segments: And from Dibon-gad they went on, and put up their tents in Almon-diblathaim.

entries.title: Numbers 33:47
segments: And from Almon-diblathaim they went on, and put up their tents in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

entries.title: Numbers 33:48
segments: And they went on from the mountains of Abarim, and put up their tents in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho;

entries.title: Numbers 33:49
segments: Planting their tents by the side of Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim in the lowlands of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 33:50
segments: ¶And in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 33:51
segments: Say to the children of Israel, When you go over Jordan into the land of Canaan,

entries.title: Numbers 33:52
segments: See that all the people of the land are forced out from before you, and put to destruction all their pictured stones, and all their metal images, and all their high places:

entries.title: Numbers 33:53
segments: And take the land for yourselves, for your resting-place: for to you I have given the land as your heritage.

entries.title: Numbers 33:54
segments: And you will take up your heritage in the land by the decision of the Lord, to every family its part; the greater the family the greater its heritage, and the smaller the family the smaller will be its heritage; wherever the decision of the Lord gives to any man his part, that will be his; distribution will be made to you by your fathers' tribes.

entries.title: Numbers 33:55
segments: But if you are slow in driving out the people of the land, then those of them who are still there will be like pin-points in your eyes and like thorns in your sides, troubling you in the land where you are living.

entries.title: Numbers 33:56
segments: And it will come about that as it was my purpose to do to them, so I will do to you.
